bioAdditions: In January 1920 'Molly', aged 9, was living with her parents Frank and Angelina 'Genet' at 133 Sand Street in Dunmore's 5th Ward, the only daughter then at home among five brothers (S3). Her parents had married about 1896 in Bisaccia, and her four older siblings were born in Italy. She was the first of the children born in Dunmore, in July 1910, three months after the April 1910 census listed the family at no. 134 (S4). After her 1931 marriage she lived with James at 1028 Bunker Hill Street in Scranton, where the 1940 census records her schooling as 5th grade (S1). By 1950 they were back on Sand Street at no. 128, a few doors from her widowed mother at no. 133 and next door to her sister Mary Pichiarello. Mollie was then working part-time as a sewing-machine operator in a lingerie factory, one of the garment shops that employed many Dunmore Italian women (S2).
